StatisticalAnalysis.description: Information describing the statistical analysis of behavioral data, including statistical tests, models, significance criteria, multiple-testing corrections, and other methods used to evaluate experimental outcomes.

effect_size_measure.description: Effect size measure reported to quantify the magnitude of observed effects or associations.

sample_size_analysis.description: Sample size or power analysis method, software, or justification used before the study.

significance_level.description: Significance threshold used for hypothesis testing (e.g., alpha).

statistical_software_version.description: Version string of the software used for statistical analysis.

behavioral_metrics.description: List of behavioral metrics or endpoints extracted from tracking data.

compute_hardware.description: Primary compute hardware used for tracking and analysis. Include model information when available.

dropped_frames_count.description: Number of video frames lost or omitted during acquisition.

dropped_frames_reason.description: Reason for dropped or omitted frames during acquisition, recording, encoding, or quality control.
examples: Corrupted frames removed during quality control
Frames dropped due to encoder performance limitations

endpoint_definitions.description: Definitions and calculation criteria used for behavioral endpoints, including thresholds, zone boundaries, event definitions, and other parameters required to reproduce endpoint calculations.
examples: Freezing defined as speed < 1 mm/s for ≥ 1 s
Center zone defined as central 50% of arena area

frames_without_tracked_bodypart.description: Percentage of frames in which no body part was tracked.

frames_without_tracked_individual.description: Percentage of frames in which no individual was tracked.

n_bodyparts_tracked.description: Number of body parts or keypoints tracked per individual.

n_individuals_tracked_per_arena.description: Number of individuals actually tracked in a single arena or trial.

preprocessing_steps.description: Preprocessing steps applied to video before tracking to enhance quality or isolate features.

tracking_algorithm.description: Algorithmic approach used to detect, identify, and track organisms in video recordings. Multiple values may be provided when tracking is performed using a pipeline of methods.

tracking_confidence_threshold.description: Confidence or likelihood threshold used to accept detections, identities, tracks, or keypoints during tracking analysis.

tracking_data_format.description: File format used to store tracking results, including coordinates, keypoints, identities, trajectories, annotations, or derived outputs.

tracking_manual_correction.description: Whether tracking results were manually reviewed, corrected, or curated after automated tracking.

tracking_notes.description: Free-text notes on the tracking analysis not captured by structured fields.

tracking_software_name.description: Name of the software used for tracking.

tracking_software_settings.description: Key tracking configuration parameters used during analysis, including software-specific settings required to reproduce tracking results.
examples: Detection threshold=25; minimum blob size=50 px

tracking_software_type.description: Indicates whether the tracking analysis was performed using a custom software or a standard package or software

tracking_software_version.description: Version string of the tracking software.
